svg.title: Auth is a hidden single point of failure
svg.desc: Force-directed node-link diagram of a microservice call graph. Each node is a service, coloured by owning team and sized by how many other services call it. Edges join services that call each other. The Auth service is the largest node: nearly every checkout, order and profile path calls it, so a stall in Auth cascades across the whole store. Hover or focus any service to highlight only the services it talks to.
svg.text: Auth is a hidden single point of failure
Service-to-service calls in an online-store backend — illustrative data
